q1_public_access.notes: TTB Federal Register Lists (FRL) are publicly downloadable government records. Updated weekly by TTB. No authentication required. Harvest metadata confirms: 'All data is publicly downloadable with no authentication required.'

q3_robots_tos.question: Is any source's robots.txt or ToS violated by our harvest method?

evidence.notes: Government public records site. CSV files explicitly published for public consumption.

q3_robots_tos.notes: TTB.gov is a U.S. Treasury Department website providing public records under FOIA. The Federal Register Lists are explicitly published as downloadable CSV files for public use. Direct file download from public URLs (/system/files/...) does not constitute web scraping. No robots.txt restrictions apply to direct file downloads. Government open data has no usage restrictions beyond standard copyright exemptions for U.S. government works.

q4_copyright.question: Are we reproducing copyrighted content verbatim?
q4_copyright.notes: All data consists of factual information: permit numbers, business names, addresses, permit types. No creative content. U.S. government works are not subject to copyright protection under 17 USC § 105. All fields contain factual data under 150 characters. No descriptive text, articles, or creative content reproduced.

q5_dual_use.question: Is any field dual-use or sensitive (security vulns, weapon specs, medical advice)?
q5_dual_use.notes: Dataset contains alcohol beverage production, distribution, and import permits. All fields are business regulatory information. No security vulnerabilities, weapon specifications, medical advice, or dual-use technology data present. Addresses are commercial facilities already publicly listed by federal regulators for compliance purposes.

q6_putnam_test.question: Could a reasonable person whose data appears here object (Putnam test)?
q6_putnam_test.notes: All data subjects are federal alcohol permit holders (breweries, wineries, distilleries, importers, wholesalers). These are regulated entities who voluntarily applied for and received federal permits. TTB publishes this data specifically for public transparency and regulatory compliance. Permit holders have zero expectation of privacy for their business name, facility address, and permit type—this information is published by law. Federal Register Lists exist precisely to make this data publicly accessible. No reasonable permit holder could object to public disclosure of information they submitted to a federal regulator for a public permit.

q7_gdpr_ccpa.question: GDPR/CCPA clean? Any EU/CA persons → ensure no PII, ensure right-to-erasure pathway.
q7_gdpr_ccpa.notes: All records represent business entities holding U.S. federal alcohol permits. No personal data under GDPR Art. 4(1) or CCPA § 1798.140. Dataset covers only U.S. states and territories (no EU locations). Even where sole proprietors appear (individual names as permit holders), the data represents their capacity as business operators with federal licenses, not as private individuals. Business contact information for licensed commercial operators is exempt from GDPR/CCPA personal data protections. No right-to-erasure pathway needed: data is (1) not personal data and (2) maintained by the U.S. government as public regulatory records.

summary: TTB Federal Register Lists (Wine Producers/Blenders, Distilled Spirits Plants, Alcohol Importers, Alcohol Wholesalers) are public U.S. government records with zero auth requirements. Data-steward removed 3 PII violations; cleaned dataset has 100% source URL coverage and contains only business entity information. All 7 ethics questions PASS. Dataset approved for product packaging and distribution.
critical_notes: NOTE: Brewery registrations are classified as tax return information under IRC Section 6103 and are NOT included in TTB's public lists. This dataset does NOT contain individual brewery permits—only wine, spirits, importer, and wholesaler permits.
All PII violations (3 rows) were successfully removed during cleaning phase.
Source URLs point to official TTB.gov CSV files, ensuring traceability and audit compliance.
